# Linux 小智 AI 聊天机器人

设计参考来源：https://github.com/78/xiaozhi-esp32  目前支持 NXP IMX6ULL 平台，在支持 全志Tina T113 V85x系列平台，以及RK 系列平台。

演示视频：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV17nXNYJE5P/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=695e352380e69504d9d46eb5e7463838
![imx6ull-pro_runxiaozhi](docs/img/imx6ull-pro_runxiaozhi.jpg)
## 项目介绍

目前项目主要参考虾哥  AI小智，我们在Linux平台进行完整支持，其中有幸联系到虾哥本人，非常感谢在调试中给予我们建议方向，我们才能以最短的时间支持完成。

QQ交流群：564992486 

AIOT边缘AI大模型开发课程：https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=901161273967



编译库，并拷贝到交叉工具链下。

交叉编译,编译speexdsp库：

下载代码：https://www.speex.org/downloads/
```
tar xvf speex-1.2.1.tar.gz
cd speex-1.2.1

export CC=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-gcc

./configure --prefix=/opt/arm_libspeex --host=arm-linux   --disable-oggtest
make
sudo make install
```

```
tar xvf speexdsp-1.2.1.tar.gz
 cd speexdsp-1.2.1/
export CC=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-gcc
./configure --prefix=/opt/arm_libspeexdsp --host=arm-linux   --disable-oggtest
make
sudo make install

把编译后arm_libspeexdsp目录下的include和lib拷贝到atk-dlrk356x-toolchain的对应目录下
/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu/sysroot/usr/include
/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu/sysroot/usr/lib

```

编译websocketpp
此库需要使用boost库进行编译

编译参考：[websocketpp的使用和boost库的交叉编译_websocke交叉编译-CSDN博客](https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43829959/article/details/108492483)

```
cd boost_1_73_0
export CC=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-gcc
./bootstrap.sh --show-libraries  //查看当前boost库中已经包含的库
/bootstrap.sh --prefix=/opt/lib_boost 
# 使用此命令可以指定boost库的安装如果不使用默认路径是 /usr/local/include 和 /usr/local/lib，分别存放头文件和各种库

# 需要修改文件“project-config.jam”
找到并修改：
if ! gcc in [ feature.values <toolset> ]
{
    using gcc : : /opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-g++ ;
}

./b2
./b2 install

```





交叉编译curl

```
cd curl-7.85.0
 
CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/arm_openssl/include" \
LDFLAGS="-L/opt/arm_openssl/lib" \
LIBS="-ldl" \
./configure --host=arm-linux \
CC=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-gcc \
CXX=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-g++ \
--with-ssl \
--enable-shared \
--enable-static \
--disable-dict \
--disable-ftp \
--disable-imap \
--disable-ldap \
--disable-ldaps \
--disable-pop3 \
--disable-proxy \
--disable-rtsp \
--disable-smtp \
--disable-telnet \
--disable-tftp \
--disable-zlib \
--without-ca-bundle \
--without-gnutls \
--without-libidn \
--without-librtmp \
--without-libssh2 \
--without-nss \
--prefix=/opt/arm_libcurl

make 

sudo make install


把编译后/opt/arm_libwebsockets目录下的include和lib拷贝到atk-dlrk356x-toolchain的对应目录下
/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu/sysroot/usr/include
/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu/sysroot/usr/lib

```












交叉编译libwebsockets:
参考：https://xiaoxiaomeng.blog.csdn.net/article/details/78717366?spm=1001.2101.3001.6650.13&utm_medium=distribute.pc_relevant.none-task-blog-2%7Edefault%7EBlogCommendFromBaidu%7ERate-13-78717366-blog-145809844.235%5Ev43%5Epc_blog_bottom_relevance_base7&depth_1-utm_source=distribute.pc_relevant.none-task-blog-2%7Edefault%7EBlogCommendFromBaidu%7ERate-13-78717366-blog-145809844.235%5Ev43%5Epc_blog_bottom_relevance_base7&utm_relevant_index=14



使用的是websocketpp，不需要交叉编译libwebsockets
使用libwebsockets需要先交叉编译openSSL

```
1、源码下载
https://distfiles.macports.org/openssl/

export CC=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-gcc
./config no-asm -shared --prefix=/opt/arm_openssl
make 
sudo make install
```

```
1、源码下载
https://github.com/warmcat/libwebsockets

本例下载的是v4.3-stable分支的代码，直接下载了zip压缩包

也可以用git下载：

git clone https://github.com/warmcat/libwebsockets.git

cd libwebsockets
mkdir build
cd build

cmake -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=Linux  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/opt/arm_libwebsockets -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-gcc  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/usr/bin/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu-g++ -DLWS_OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIRS=/opt/arm_openssl/include -DLWS_OPENSSL_LIBRARIES="/opt/arm_openssl/lib/libssl.so;/opt/arm_openssl/lib/libcrypto.so" ..

make
sudo make install

把编译后/opt/arm_libwebsockets目录下的include和lib拷贝到atk-dlrk356x-toolchain的对应目录下
/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu/sysroot/usr/include
/opt/atk-dlrk356x-toolchain/aarch64-buildroot-linux-gnu/sysroot/usr/lib

```
